notes.title: Patch notes 1.01
notes.content: [p]Today marks 1 month since [i]Double Trip[/i] was released! We're incredibly grateful for all the support we've received during this time ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]We also want to thank the team at [i][b]Thinky Games[/b][/i] for publishing an article about the game! You can read it here: [url="https://thinkygames.com/features/double-trip-is-the-perfect-sokoban-for-beginners-and-those-after-a-cosy-break/"]Thinky Games - Double Trip article[/url][/p][p][/p][p]And a big thank you to [i][b]El_Yuste[/b][/i] for featuring Double Trip at [i][b]Ñ3[/b][/i], the Spanish video game conference![/p][p][/p][h1]PATCH NOTES [/h1][p][/p][h2]Quality of Life Improvements: [/h2][list][*][p]Added a confirmation popup when changing the resolution.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Bugfixes: [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where \[spoiler]the statue would disappear if the map was restarted before finishing the final section\[/spoiler].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the credits music wouldn’t play after completing all levels (\[spoiler]if the final zone had been completed\[/spoiler]).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the camera would zoom in on unintended areas in 2-Player mode.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added a confirmation popup when changing the resolution.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where [spoiler]the statue would disappear if the map was restarted before finishing the final section[/spoiler].
Fixed a bug where the credits music wouldn’t play after completing all levels (["spoiler"]if the final zone had been completed[/spoiler]).
Fixed a bug where the camera would zoom in on unintended areas in 2-Player mode.

notes.title: Ready for February Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45455351/6b76ee1ab53ea708192707455ccbccf79a61db26.png[/img]

[b]Double Trip will join Steam Next Fest: February 2025 Edition, starting February 24[/b]
Also, the game can now be played on MacOS and SteamOS!

[h2][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Level changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Replaced level "Blockage" with "Woodwork"
[*] Removed level "Blockage"
[*] Added new level "Falling Up"
[*] Fixed unintended solution from level "Nook"
[/list]
[h3][b]Game improvements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a controls page in the menu
[*] Added support for MacOS and SteamOS
[*] Changed yellowish outline of the selected character to a white one
[*] Small performance improvement
[/list]
[h3][b]Fixed bugs:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Credits sequence of the menu not showing up after initial animation
[*] Log animation bugs
[*] Fast switching between characters causing visual issues
[/list]

[i]Have fun![/i] ːsteamhappyː
